note: Private campground at the foot of Windrock Mountain near Oliver Springs, with a renovated bathhouse, tent sites, bunkhouses and small cabins beside the RV loop. Some sites were being enlarged and moved in 2026. --Claude
summary: Operating private campground, 31 water/electric RV sites (22 x 30A $40, 9 x 50A $45, tax included; 41-105 ft, 7 pull-thru), dump + bathhouse, FareHarbor booking, bookable through winter. Google 4.9/230. Passes the gate and long-stay tests. Phone 865-435-6009 -> 865-609-4488. OHV: no trail marketing on its own pages - general campground (reviewer note).
flags: OHV (flag, reviewer decides): the campground sits at the foot of Windrock Mountain near the Windrock off-road park, and the stored note called it 'Popular as OHV-trail-access base'. The operator's four pages (home, services, about, contact) and its 31 FareHarbor RV listings say nothing about ATVs, off-road trails or trail access from the campground - it sells RV sites, tents, bunkhouses and cabins as a general campground. Read as a general campground with an OHV clientele, not a staging camp; keep. Not checked: whether Windrock Park trails can be ridden from the gate (no operator statement either way).

GATE FACTS (private): cheapest RV night $40 tax included (30-amp water/electric), $45 for 50-amp; operator pages and FareHarbor live 2026-11-24 (same figures read 2026-10-15); passes. GOOGLE 4.9 from 230 reviews; RV Life 5*/$$ stored. Operator-posted 'Military/FD/PD Discount'.

LONG-STAY: five tests pass - (1) nothing discourages nightly guests (only 'make us your second home'); (2) nightly rates posted; (3) Google 4.9/230; (4) FareHarbor sells every RV site by the night and 8 of 9 sampled sites were open on most nights in December 2026, February and May 2027 (site 31 never open - possibly a long-term or held site); (5) no lots sold.

PHONE: stored 865-435-6009 -> 865-609-4488 (operator pages, FareHarbor company record and Google). The old number still appears in FareHarbor's tent listing ('Please call 865-435-6009 to book'). Website https://www.windrockgapcampground.com/ confirmed; the FareHarbor link is written to booking.url.

SITES: 31 RV sites on FareHarbor (numbers 1-32, no 6; the operator map also draws a 33) - stored 33 replaced; 22 x 30-amp, 9 x 50-amp (stored inclusion evidence said 8 x 50 / 24 x 30). Sewer: none at the sites (water and electric only, dump station) - sewer false written.
SEASON: no season statement on the operator pages; FareHarbor sells nights in December, February and May (consistent with the stored evidence's 'year-round'), season left unwritten.
Pin 36.06237,-84.31580 vs Google 36.06287,-84.31623 (~65 m) - fine. Waterfront 'not waterfront' unchanged.
